resources.string: Watchpost Notifications
Watchpost Notifications (relay to the Watchpost agent)
Watchpost notification local relay
Channel between Watchpost and its notifications companion, reserved for apps signed with the same key.

Optional Watchpost module. It reads the notifications displayed on this phone and hands them to the Watchpost agent installed on this same phone, which sends them to your server with its other events. This module has no Internet access, keeps nothing and only passes data to the Watchpost agent signed with the same key. It is separate from the agent so that the agent (a device administrator) never has access to notifications itself.

What is passed on

For each notification displayed or removed: the app\'s package name, category, channel, importance, ongoing notification or not. The title and text (512 characters at most) only if you enable "Notification content" in Watchpost (Collectors › Notifications tab); when disabled, they never leave this module. Runs of 4 to 8 digits (validation codes) are replaced by •••• before sending, unless you disable masking; this also masks years, round amounts or postal codes, and does not see alphanumeric codes. Not passed on: the notifications of Watchpost and of this module, repeated updates of the same notification, updates of ongoing notifications (music, download, timer, call, navigation), group summaries, and anything beyond 20 events per app per 10 minutes.
App lists (saved in Watchpost)

One app per line, identified by its package name (example: com.example.bank; visible in Settings › Apps › the app, or in the Watchpost app list). These lists only recognize an app by its exact name: the default list (common banking and payment apps, authenticators, password managers, SMS, phone) is necessarily incomplete, add your own sensitive apps to it. Every change is saved in Watchpost and reported to the server (agent.config_changed).

Remove access, uninstall

Remove access: "Notification access setting" button above, then disable Watchpost Notifications (in Settings, look for "Notification access": the path varies with the One UI version), or through ADB: scripts/notifier-access.sh --revoke. The module stops reading notifications immediately. To stop everything on the agent side, rather disable the "Notifications" collector in Watchpost. Uninstall: button below (Uninstall), or scripts/uninstall-notifier.sh. The Watchpost agent keeps working without this module (its "Notifications" collector becomes "unavailable").
